sections.summary: On the Order List, pressing Export CSV shows no file and no message after filtering by Shipped.
steps: 1. Sign in to the Admin site as a store manager.
sections.expected: A CSV file with the filtered orders downloads.
sections.actual: Nothing happens. The console shows POST /api/orders/export 500 (Internal Server Error).

summary_title: date filter resets after changing page

sections.url_note: Specifically affects the date filter on the order list
sections.summary: Changing to page 2 of the Order List clears the date filter.
sections.expected: The date filter stays applied on every page.
sections.actual: The filter is cleared and all orders are shown.

summary_title: order details take nine seconds to open

sections.url_note: Specifically affects how long an order takes to open
sections.summary: Opening an order with many items takes about nine seconds.
sections.expected: The order opens in under two seconds.
sections.actual: The page shows a spinner for about nine seconds.
